591.synopsis: In 21st century, world entered a new stage of VR games…and “YGGDRASIL” is considered top of all MMORPG…but, After announcing that all its servers will be off, the internet game ‘Yggdrasil’ shut down…or so was supposed to happen, but for some reason, the player character did not log out some time after the server was closed. NPCs start to become sentient. A normal youth who loves gaming in the real world seemed to have been transported into an alternate world along with his guild, becoming the strongest mage with the appearance of a skeleton, Momonga. He leads his guild “Ainz Ooal Gown” towards an unprecedented legendary fantasy adventure!

847.synopsis:
The Great Thousand World. It is a place where numerous planes intersect, a place where many clans live and a place where a group of lords assemble. The Heavenly Sovereigns appear one by one from the Lower Planes and they will all display a legend that others would desire as they pursue the road of being a ruler in this boundless world.
In the Endless Fire Territory that the Flame Emperor controls, thousands of fire blazes through the heavens.
Inside the Martial Realm, the power of the Martial Ancestor frightens the heaven and the earth.
At the West Heaven Temple, the might of the Emperor of a Hundred Battles is absolute.
In the Northern Desolate Hill, a place filled with thousands of graves, the Immortal Owner rules the world.
A boy from the Northern Spiritual Realm comes out, riding on a Nine Netherworld Bird, as he charges into the brilliant and diverse world. Just who can rule over their destiny of their path on becoming a Great Ruler? In the Great Thousand World, many strive to become a Great Ruler.

1103.synopsis:
Su Yun was a prodigy who was blessed by the gods. However, life was not always so smooth sailing. After reaching the 6th stage in the Spirit Novice Realm, his progress stagnated due to having incurred a rare medical condition.
A few years went by, and Su Yun spent all his time gambling and drinking, wasting his youth away, but one day everything changed. Qing Er, the only one who stood by him, was forced by her clan to be a sacrificial bride for someone she didn’t love, only to be executed by the groom on the wedding night for fleeing. Revengeful, he scoured the world for a cure for his rare medical condition from both the righteous and villainous sides.
Countless years go by, and Su Yun not only finds a way to cure his rare condition but also gains immense knowledge of a myriad of martial techniques in the process.
But before he could fully cure himself, he receives news that the groom had suffered an assault that damaged his internal organs. Rather than wait for decades to become fully cured, Su Yun decided to hatch a plan for the assassination of the groom. Unfortunately, he underestimated the strength of the groom’s family and was killed instead.
Then he regains consciousness. He comes to a realization that he had been taken back to 15 years in the past. This time, he vows to protect Qing Er, first curing his rare medical condition. Will he learn from the mistakes of his previous life or will everything still be set in stone?

1615.synopsis: “I love you” – Arita hears the confession from his junior, Hirose. Arita is shocked to know that the younger junior has been in love, and he is the love interest. As you begin to comprehend, everything is just hot and painful words. Non-pained facial expressions show occasionally in contact with a cold attitude, always in a calm Hirose, Arita starts to open your heart, but little by little -.

2895.synopsis:
I think you’ve lost if you fall in love.
—Hinooka Homura. Seiran High School 1st year.
She likes to talk with friends. She dislikes essays. She’s the type that gets sleepy after thinking for too long. Basically, she has the air of someone who had failed her high school debut. Her classmate Touya Takumi surprised her one day by asking, “Why don’t you try becoming a mage?”
Without fully understanding what she was getting herself into, Homura soon finds herself and Touya joining up with the Exploration Club president, a Yamato Nadeshiko named Misasagi Mayo, and a magically powered golem/android named Ameno in order to explore a recently discovered sister planet to Earth named Nutella. Nutella is enormous in size, easily dwarfing Jupiter, and yet somehow it is mysteriously and magically linked with Earth.

5199.synopsis:
I was just living in modern Japan, when I realized I reincarnated in a early modern European styled world… no, it’s just like Europe, right dad? Anyway, I was reincarnated in a European fantasy. This is the epic tale of I, Joseph Wallace. Probably.
My second birthplace, the Silesia Kingdom, was in a precarious situation. The neighboring kingdoms military were pressuring the Silesia Kingdom until it collapses. I felt I should use my previous world’s knowledge to the fullest so I enrolled in a military academy… to become a cheat hero. Yep. I did not swing a sword in my previous life, I did not ride a horse in my previous life. Magic? What is that? I recalled “unnecessary information”… it’d be great if my story starts.

6223.synopsis: A Spin-off novel of High School DxD by Ichiei Ishibumi bundled with the Blu-Ray special editions of the Season 3 Anime, High School DxD BorN. Set in a time-travel setting between post-Volume 14 present timeline and thirty years into the future.

7759.synopsis:
She was the head of a powerful, medicine-orientated aristocratic family.

8527.synopsis:
— Science is the ultimate game changer —
A super genius in the form of a young boy appears in modern day Japan.
With his help, cold fusion along with ultra-efficient batteries and motors become a reality, ending dependence on fossil fuels. As a result, Japan’s industries and its society itself goes through a monumental revolution. He goes on to help solve problems including the prediction and prevention of earthquakes and the cleanup of radiation from disasters like the Fukushima Nuclear Accident.
Furthermore, thanks to the invention of the gravity engine, Japan takes to space and begins exploring other planets.
How will Earth’s expansion into the galaxy unfold?
This novel tells a tale which harkens back to the Golden Age of Science Fiction (1940s-50s) from a uniquely realistic point of view by leveraging modern day science.
associated_names: Revolution（科学の力で日本を変革、そして宇宙へ）

9295.synopsis:
They possessed a title that could be passed down through generations, but they were not nobles. Their family’s ancestry was long and illustrious, yet they were not powerful. The current scion of the family believed he had secured his employment for a lifetime by inheriting the position that had been passed down from his forefathers. However, this prison chief of a yamen, a government establishment, had his little world unexpectedly thrown on its head by a swindler acting like a mystical being. Thus, a tyrant who could cover the sky was created.
Yang Ling[1] was known as Yang the Beheader, and Yang Fan[2] was known as the Plague Doctor, but our protagonist was dubbed with many names, the Insane Dianshi[3], the ****head Prefectural Judge, Night Emperor… Every one of those nicknames represents his legend.
——————————————————

10831.synopsis:
After defeating all the enemies of the Murim Alliance, the Demonic Alliance and the internal enemies; Cheon Hajin, the master of the Murim Alliance who held the title Strongest Under Heaven brought forth peace to all of Kang Ho. But one day he dies unexpectedly.
Once he openes his eyes, he is in a body of a twenty year old youth named Byeok Ridan. How will the man who once held the title Strongest Under Heaven live this new life? And what will his death entail to Kang Ho?

12879.synopsis:
First, this isn’t a story about how to seek survival during Doomsday! It’s rather about how to bring about the end of of times, to bring down the curtain on the world. It’s about how to set off a Zombie frenzy, how to lead the Devil into invasion, and how to guide the descent of Zerg! In this game of doom, I’m the source of everything!
Second, I need to thank those brethren who accompanied me until now. My thanks go to the Lich Monarch, Arthas Menethil (game: World of Warcraft), bringer of endless winter and death; to Alex Mercer (game: Prototype), who created life by consuming viruses; to the Worst Spirit Tokisaki Kurumi (Light Novel: Date a Live), controller of time; to the Magus Ascendant Xerath (Game: League of Legends), imprisoned by runes.

15695.synopsis:
500 years ago, Chen Xi was devoured by a crack in the void and was transported into a cultivation world.
500 years later, he returned back to Earth after enduring through several hardships and discovered that only 5 years had gone by.
…
In the courtyard, beauty at the side, a candle flame wavering.
A gush of clear wind, half a full moon, the peach tree remains unchanging.
…
Wait, whose kid is this?! Why is she calling me papa? Gazing at the little girl in front of him with skin as pale as jade, Chen Xi froze.
…
　
Returning home from cultivation, starting as a stay-at-home dad.
In this life, not fighting to be a king nor claiming to be a tyrant, only praying to peacefully be a wife-pampering mad devil and a child-protecting daddy!

15951.synopsis:
When mountains and seas separate me from my beloved, I shall flatten those mountains and fill in those seas. 
Eating, drinking and whoring — since his banishment to the Nanjing Ministry of War, these had become Xie Yilu’s entire life. In this lawless age, scholars and Eunuch Faction sycophants clawed at each other’s throats and each grand chamberlain wielded more power and influence than the last. As someone who could not master the arts of flattery and bootlicking, Xie Yilu’s only wish was to be a conscientious minor official. 
Yet who knew that in such chaotic times, one could still encounter written confessions that sung out in a voice as fresh as the light of dawn? 
Plum blossoms are but fleeting visitors; only pines will be one’s constant companions. 
Xie Yilu had fantasised about such a person, but he could never have imagined that this confidant like an immortal ascended from the dust of worldly affairs was actually him?!
An old stone lantern stand, a page of powerful calligraphy and a set of heartstrings plucked out of the blue. Looking up at that frosty visage, Xie Yilu could not help but wonder — what is he hiding behind that haughty mask?

16207.synopsis: Imperial prince of the Ka country Li Sekka is a beautiful, unassuming youth, but he holds an important secret. He possesses both genders. And as such he serves as a substitute for his late sister, who was to be the next empress. During this time, Ka country is invaded by the large army of the neighbouring Yoh country. Sekka ran away from the country dressed as the Imperial Princess, but was captured by the Emperor of Yoh country Ryuu Kishoh and had to enter the man’s harem as a princess. “If he learned that I am a man, I would be killed…” But just as he was feeling uneasy, he was ordered by Kishoh to spend a night with him…!?

After facing her fiancé’s betrayal, things take an unexpected turn after Tang Mo’er inadvertently gets involved with the Capital’s preeminent magnate, Gu Mohan.

Gu Mohan hands a baby over into her arms. “My dearest wife, be good. That’s our second child.” 
And so Tang Mo’er can only hustle and take care of her two children, but unbeknownst to her, Young Master Gu has also been coveting her love and affection…

25679.synopsis:
According to Jianghu rumors, the following levels for Mei Zihan’s fans are:
After watching one of his local dramas, they are passersby fans; after watching ten, they are true love fans; after watching all of them, they are fans of the ultimate ashes. But on the way to upgrade fan status, most do not go from passersby fans to true love fans. Instead, the transformation is the blackening of a fan.
Mei Zihan has a glorious name, but he often acts in soap opera with bitter mother-in-law conflicts and anti Japanese war drama. Before meeting Jiang Ying, Mei Zihan’s biggest wish was to become a middle-aged handsome uncle. After meeting him, he was forced to act in the theatre group and go home to practice. Lariette is diagnosed with a disease which gives her a three-month deadline. 
“Since I am going to die, I might as well go crazy!” 
It started with screwing her fiancé and having a relationship with the monster Duke. 
But she didn’t realize it until it was too late. There was no time limit and it was a misdiagnosis!

29007.synopsis:
Meng Yang had done a lot of s*upid and wrong things in his life. Jumping around like a clown, annoying and unpleasant. Only after his tragic death did he know that he was a cannon fodder written in a book who only existed to set off the protagonist shou.
Although he certainly had done things to hate, the protagonist gong and the protagonist shou were not totally innocent. The protagonist gong betrayed him first, then the protagonist shou framed him. So when he was reborn, he decided…
Marry the protagonist gong’s rich father and give the protagonist a few younger brothers to divide the property.
He wanted to be pregnant soon but thinking that the old man was getting older it would be more difficult. But he didn’t expect that the old man was not only strong, he was even more handsome than the protagonist gong. The steady momentum and charm of that mature man was so attractive that a certain person couldn’t close their legs…ahhhh, he accidentally told the truth. He just couldn’t hold his mouth.
Luo Xiu and his ex-wife had been in a business marriage and were divorced for many years. He really did not expect that he would marry a boy so much younger than him, that he would become an extra son to raise.
He just didn’t expect this delicate and tender little guy to be so attractive, making him pamper him and spoil him and eventually take his heart.

30543.synopsis:
There has been a lot of gossip in the upper circle of capital city lately.
Rich anonymous 1: I heard that the abducted daughter of Mayor Chen’s family was finally found, it’s rumored that she was sold to the deep remote mountain area and had suffered a lot.

And soon, she would divorce her powerful husband and lead a miserable life. To prevent that from happening, Ning Meng has to find ways to stay by his side. That would mean she would make a lot of enemies along the way. Time for her to use the knowledge from the real world to turn her life around and not let others take advantage of her.

32591.synopsis:
Sage Dwight subjugated the Demon Lord along with the hero.
 They, who had returned peace to the world, were suspected of becoming the next Demon Lord and were pushed into the valley of the dead to die.
Ten years later.
Dwight quietly survived at the bottom of the ravine, becoming a skeleton that lost all its flesh.
With deep remorse, he held the hero’s dead body and said to himself.
“What’s wrong is the world. I have to prove it to them.”
Having resolved himself, Dwight ate the Miasma of the valley of the dead.
He became an existence that surpassed the previous Demon Lord and headed for the surface, leading countless undead with him.
All for the sake of world peace.

36175.synopsis:
Gu Xiaoyou, she nearly died in the foreign country because of a man who had an affair with her aunt.
Watching the X-rated video on her Ipad, she decided to go back to her country, and finally slapped this jerk in the airport lobby!
Having left the country for three years, she had nowhere to go but standing on the sidewalk. Then she simply got into a stranger’s car that almost hit her and said bluntly: “I am injured! So I am gonna blackmail you!” And then she fell asleep…..
She woke up to find herself locked in the car, so she asked someone to smash it……
But surprisingly，the car’s owner, Li Junhuan, came to her home for the indemnity, and claimed to be her uncle! Excuse me?
Until one day, Gu Xiaoyou suddenly announced, “The father of my child is Li Junghuan!”

Their relationship made these two families the biggest joke in the town.

But he never thought she would have cursed him through carving a jade cicada and gave it to him…….
While Li Junhuan said: “There is nothing to be scared, I am willing to give my everything to her because she is my benefactor, and also my woman.”

38735.synopsis:
As a popular variety show artist with a talent for trolling, Lin Luo is on the verge of being beaten up every day, until one day, she suddenly transmigrated as a cannon fodder with the same name as her in an unfinished novel. The system told her that if she wanted to go back, she had no choice but to flatter the male protagonist, and to figure out how good the male protagonist was.

However …… she slowly found out that the boss looked at her with a weirder and weirder gaze, and that the favorability, after many ups and downs, finally didn’t rise anymore.

39759.synopsis:
From what he sees he can know everything that has already happened. From what he hears he can see through the treachery of the human heart. From what he senses he can uncover the deepest secrets hidden in the mind. 
Knowledge is a burden. Staring into the night sky, Huang Ji sensed a malice that originated from the entire universe. And along with it, the dire situation humanity faced. As a mere farm boy from a remote village on Earth, he thought to himself, “I know too much.”
From science to myth, to even the deepest secrets of the universe…in the end they are just pieces of information waiting to be decoded.
With humanity being raised like farm animals by an advanced civilization, the only way out of this impossible predicament is for Huang Ji to compete with the aliens to see who knows more!

40015.synopsis:
She has a crush on a boy, thinking that he is cold and abstinent. She didn’t expect him to be a pe*vert who couldn’t have enough.

40271.synopsis:
Adelaide, a succubus, inherited a measly F-rank dungeon and a mountain of debt. 
To avoid the Demon King’s debt collectors—who threatened to chop off at least one of her arms—she had no choice but to manage the dungeon and pay off her debts.
It seemed impossible, but…
“Are you my master?”
“No, I’m the master of this dungeon…”
“Yes, then you are my master.”
Upon arriving at the dungeon, she gained the perfect manager.
“Don’t touch those insignificant beings, consume me.”
The devil, the apex predator of the demon world, offered himself as nourishment.
“I brought the prince’s head as an offering for you.” 
The legendary hero brought offerings she didn’t even ask for.

40783.synopsis:
Is the Royal poisonous mushroom all right?
The prodigal son of the Royal family, once a beloved Prince of Kingdom Lechen, had to put down the crown in exchange for being the principle figure of an unparalleled scandal.
The Royal mushroom, Björn Denyster.

43599.synopsis:
In his previous life, Ye Yunlan’s appearance was destroyed by a fire. For years, he was misunderstood by the world and his reputation was notorious. Once reborn, he returned to three hundred years ago. He escapes from the fire. This time, his face was healthy, but his roots have been damaged while saving people, breaking his cultivation and leaving him suffering from sickness. But, Ye Yunlan didn’t care. In his previous life, he wandered for a long time, so in this life he just wanted to live a peaceful life. However, he soon discovered that his former Senior Brother who abolished his golden core, his Sect Master who imprisoned him for a hundred years, his Daoist companion who gave him away to the Demon Venerable, those who hated him and disliked him… all of a sudden, they began to treat him nicely and courteously. 46159.synopsis:

Ayane, who usually helps her father with his work, suddenly receives a message from her best friend since elementary school, Ryoka Shimizu, and decides to play the VRMMO 《Sekandaria Online》.

47439.synopsis:
Shu Ning read a CEO novel. In it, there was a beautiful and tragic villain. He was clearly the true young master of a wealthy family, but he was switched at birth and became a delinquent. Later, he returned to the wealthy family to go against the fake young master, fought for his fiancée, and finally fell from the top of a building and died.
After his death, the fake young master inherited his money and his fiancée, his career and his love.

1. Take care of his health.
2. Live a good life with Cheng Mofei.
Shen Yu resolutely filled out his college application to Cheng Mofei’s former university, packed his belongings, and headed alone to the northern city where they had spent seven years together.
The first time they met was at the freshman reception. Cheng Mofei was being confessed to by a junior, but his face showed clear disdain as he said, “I’m straight, I’m not interested in men.”
Shen Yu: “?”
He distinctly remembered it was Cheng Mofei who had made the first move on him.
The second time they met was in their dorm room. Shen Yu had used a few connections to become Cheng Mofei’s roommate. 
Cheng Mofei threw an arm around his shoulders in a familiar way, leaned into his neck to sniff for a long moment, and asked, “Brother, what did you put on? It smells good.”
Shen Yu replied with the name of a body wash brand.
It was Cheng Mofei’s favorite body wash—the same one that bore witness to countless passionate moments they shared in the bathroom.
The next day, an identical bottle of body wash appeared in their dorm bathroom.
The third time they met was in the campus clinic. An athletic student had been harassing the pretty freshman, Shen Yu. 
Cheng Mofei strode up, shielding Shen Yu behind him, his gaze icy as he said, “My xiongdi is a straight man. Take your filthy thoughts elsewhere.”
Shen Yu: “…” Actually, he wasn’t.
While Shen Yu was torn over how to bend the still-closeted Cheng Mofei, Cheng Mofei seemed to be unknowingly courting him every day.
“Shen Yu and I hit it right away. We’ll definitely be good brothers for life.”
“What’s wrong with good brothers sharing a bed?”
“Good brothers should shower together.”
“We straight guys don’t care about stuff like that, do we?”
Shen Yu: “…”
—
Later, Cheng Mofei began to notice a few peculiarities about his “good brother.”
 He realized Shen Yu seemed to have someone special in his heart. His phone password was a date—one that turned out to be their future anniversary. 
He even muttered someone’s nickname in his sleep. And all this time, the body wash he had been using was the exact scent loved by that mysterious someone.
And… that “someone” seemed to be a man!
Cheng Mofei was completely floored.
On the anniversary from his previous life, Shen Yu had dressed up carefully and bought Cheng Mofei’s favorite small cake, hoping to celebrate this special day with him in this lifetime. 
But as soon as he opened the dorm door, he was pinned against the wall.
The familiar fragrance lingered at the tip of his nose as Cheng Mofei, gritting his teeth, said: “You’re not allowed to be with some wild man.”
Shen Yu: “?”
Reading Notes
1. “Straight” × closeted × mutual attraction (both sides fall).
2. Sweet campus story. Shen Yu didn’t choose the university just for Cheng Mofei—it was already his best option.
3. Only Shen Yu is reborn; Cheng Mofei is not. The story revolves around the tension caused by Cheng Mofei initially being homophobic and “straight.”
4. Extras include: Cheng Mofei after Shen Yu’s death in the previous life + memory recovery in this life.
5. Characters are not perfect—please be understanding.
6. All place names are fictional—don’t map them onto real locations.

99151.synopsis:
“Trias Marigold is innocent. I’ll prove it.”
In the world of Flower Mail, every person is born with an inherent talent for a specific job. A young man bearing the Demon Lord job is subjugated and arrested, accused of plotting world conquest.
Freya Blossom, an eccentric lawyer from the Lotus Federation specializing in criminal cases, firmly believes in Demon Lord Trias Marigold’s innocence. Against the prevailing prejudice that all Demon Lords are evil, Freya diligently gathers evidence. Gradually revealed is a distorted world system, one that fears the “omnipotent Demon Lord possessing the power of all jobs” and maintains balance by branding him as evil.
People cannot choose their job abilities. Discriminated against simply for being born a Demon Lord, Trias is falsely accused of a mass mu*der committed by a band of thieves. To further incriminate him, a fabricated confession of his intent to conquer the world is produced.
By gaining the support of one of the heroes, who is vaguely aware of the truth and plagued by guilt, Freya succeeds in overturning the trial and rescuing Trias.
Trias joins the law firm operated by Freya and her paralegal partner, Techno. And so begins their boisterous and bright new life together in the office.

101711.synopsis: With his innate spiritual abilities, ‘Kang Yeon-woo’ was destined to become either a shaman or an entertainer. After surviving a life-threatening event, he gains the ability to extend his life by resolving grudges. His life takes a complete turn when he meets top star ‘Kwon Sung-hyun’ while handling a request

101967.synopsis:
The Fox Clan’s Mutant, Tia.  
Lost and wandering, he ends up captured by the empire’s Grand Duke, Wymon. 
Tia struggles desperately to return to his territory, but… 
“You’re not going back.” 
Wymon has no intention of letting go of the fox who has stumbled into his solitary world.

102735.synopsis:
Lucella, who lost her only sibling, her sister, was now raising her sister’s son, Lucian, on her own.
One day, she realizes that this world was actually inside a book, and Lucian was destined to become a villain in the future. Worse, he will be a terrible villain who torments the protagonist and gets brutally killed!
“I can’t let my precious nephew die!”
To keep her promise to her sister and to save the nephew she loves, she decides to raise Lucian to be a good person instead of a villain.
But then…
“Auntie, I want you to marry the Marquis.”
As if raising him properly wasn’t hard enough, now he’s saying weird things!
“My uncle might not be the best husband material, but… at least he looks decent.”
Even the original story’s heroine was seriously trying to set up a matchmaking meeting.
“I agree with that opinion.”
And her uncle just nods along like it makes sense.
“Sorry, but I won’t think about marriage until I raise Lucian properly.”
“So, you mean… as long as Lucian is raised well, it’s okay?”
“Th-That’s not what I—”
“I understand.”
Why is everyone looking so excited?!

102991.synopsis:
Carpenter Xue Wenhao pulled an all-nighter, struggling through a danmei farming novel that his sister forced him to read. The novel featured a scummy gong—who, coincidentally, shared his exact name.
The next morning, he woke up inside the book.
And worse still, he was that very same s*umbag—a lazy, abusive husband who mistreated his ger spouse and beat their children.
Nanmu Village was just as its name suggested: filled with nanmu trees. The entire village—front yards, backyards, mountain slopes—was covered with golden-threaded nanmu wood.
Seeing this, Carpenter Xue felt as if he had struck gold. Without hesitation, he resumed his woodworking craft, making furniture, earning money, pampering his husband, and leading the entire village toward prosperity.
The only problem?
Every piece of furniture he crafted seemed to possess special abilities:
Cedarwood increased certain physical functions and improved fertility.
Walnut wood enhanced intelligence.
Pearwood strengthened the body.
Poplar wood provided cooling effects.
Huangboluo wood retained warmth.
Nanmu wood relieved fatigue.
Rosewood brought inner peace…
Before he knew it, Carpenter Xue had accidentally become an imperial merchant.

104527.synopsis: During the military dictatorship of World War III, Major Dohan of the 1st Special Abilities Brigade, “Black Horse,” defects from Yeongamdo, an island facility that trains human weapons, with the help of his brother.

105295.synopsis:
For three years, Rong Shu lived in the shadow of a love that was never hers. When her husband, Gu Changjin, reclaimed his identity as the lost prince, her fate was sealed with a single poisoned cup. It was at that moment that Rong Shu understood—nothing had ever been a coincidence.
Three years of cold indifference had made one thing clear: Gu Changjin loathed her.  
Yet fate had other plans—when she awoke, she had returned to the day after their wedding.
Determined to break free from the chains of the past, she sought only one thing—an early divorce, a clean slate. But as she unraveled the truth, she discovered that her past life’s death was no accident and that from the moment of her birth, she had been ensnared in a far greater scheme.
Even in the deepest abyss, one must still strive toward the light. Even as an abandoned pawn, one must march forward—unyielding, unafraid.
This is a story of dual rebirth, where two souls wade through the fog of their past lives to uncover the hidden truths. A tale of deep love, intricate power plays, and fateful redemption, filled with breathtaking twists, emotional intensity, and a romance that burns slow but bright. With elegant prose and a masterful balance of politics and passion, this novel is a true gem.
associated_names: My Obsessed Ex-Husband, the Crown Prince (Rebirth)
The Paranoid Prince is My Ex-Husband
偏执太子是我前夫（重生）

106319.synopsis:
Xiong Miao, seorang mahasiswa berprestasi di Universitas Pengobatan Tradisional Tiongkok, dipindahkan ke dunia manusia setengah hewan. Ia berubah menjadi panda merah yang, setelah terpisah dari orang tuanya, diselamatkan oleh seekor macan tutul salju raksasa.
Sambil memeluk ekornya sendiri yang berbulu lebat dan berwarna cokelat kemerahan, serta memandang ekor milik yang lain yang bahkan lebih besar dan panjang, Xiong Miao berpikir: Aku ingin menyentuhnya…
Xue Yuan menatap manusia setengah hewan betina yang dia tangkap—yang bahkan memiliki dua anak bersamanya—dan dengan geraman, dia membawanya kembali ke sarangnya.
Awalnya, Xiong Miao hanya ingin hidup damai di sukunya, tetap hangat, kenyang, dan terbebas dari penyakit. Namun, entah karena usahanya sendiri atau kerja keras para manusia buas di sukunya, permukiman itu berkembang menjadi sebuah desa, dan akhirnya menjadi sebuah kota…
Tunggu, bagaimana seorang mahasiswa pengobatan tradisional Tiongkok bisa begitu mahir dalam pengembangan infrastruktur?!
Seiring membaiknya kehidupan di pemukiman itu, Xiong Miao mulai menyadari bahwa teman sekamarnya sekaligus rekan bisnisnya memandangnya dengan cara yang semakin tidak pantas.
Hingga suatu malam yang gelap dan berangin, Xiong Miao dibawa kembali ke sarang, dilahap habis, dan keesokan harinya pinggangnya terasa sakit. Ia menghibur dirinya sendiri: Ini hanya saling menguntungkan… saling menguntungkan…
Namun, beberapa bulan kemudian—ia hamil! Xue Yuan menatapnya dengan mata abu-biru yang dalam dan penuh tekad, lalu menyatakan dengan tegas: “Ini anakku!”
associated_names: 小熊猫在兽世养崽种田

106575.synopsis:
I became the protagonist of a reverse harem romance novel where the main character ends up committing su*cide, but instead of being a female, the protagonist is male.
With the gender reversal, the female protagonist becomes male, and the male protagonists are all turned into females.
So, does that mean it’s a harem story, and isn’t that a good thing? 
Well, it would have been if it weren’t for the obsessive and toxic elements.

107087.synopsis:
Gu Nian groggily boarded a transmigration bus and found herself inside a 1970s historical novel she had read, becoming a cannon-fodder female supporting character.  
Her scummy older brother and sister-in-law not only stole her job but also forced her to go to the countryside in place of her delicate niece. In retaliation, she reported them, sending them off for reformation, and then immediately signed up, sending her white lotus niece to the remote Northwest.  
Using the system, she emptied the house of valuables and took all the supplies her parents left her before heading to the countryside.  
After arriving, she was busy completing missions while dealing with the novel’s male and female leads, leaving her with no time to rest.  
One day, she overheard a rumor that a military officer returning to visit his village had taken a liking to her and insisted on marrying her. She thought it was just gossip—until they met, and the rumor became reality.
associated_names: 下乡嫁军官：系统有你是我的福气

109647.synopsis:
“Leon never engraved a contract seal on me when he was my master. Leon truly cherished me when I was a s*ave…”
“And yet, I didn’t care about Leon’s feelings at all and only thought about controlling him with a contract seal… If I do this, I’m no different from those other disgusting people who ab*se their s*aves.”
She smiled as she looked at the contract seal, then opened her m**th.
“…I’ll use it anyway.”
“Let’s make the contract now!”
associated_names: The S*ave I Banished Became My Master

111439.synopsis:
Wrote a will after a failed confession? What the heck, this is me from eighteen years ago?
Having traveled back in time, Jiang Zhou cursed his past self for being an idiot and decided to focus on making money.
First, using his memories, he reported a mu*derer who had been on the run for five years.
He received a 500,000 yuan reward and officially started his own business.
School Goddess: Why are you acting so cold after I rejected you?
Jiang Zhou: Love is a deep game. Who’s being real, who knows? Let’s part peacefully, alright?
School Goddess: But you clearly said you liked me!
Jiang Zhou: I was just joking. Not interested. Don’t follow me.
School Goddess: If you say that again, I’ll cry and never talk to you again.
Jiang Zhou: Go ahead and cry. What’s that got to do with me?
School Goddess: ???
Start a company, fall in love, mess with the School Goddess.
Back from the past, Jiang Zhou made up for all his regrets.
Women are strange. If you chase them, they get cold.
If you stop caring, they end up crying!
associated_names: 表白你不接受，我变心你哭什么？

112463.synopsis:
I turned on the broadcast as a test. This is the second broadcast.
–Give me the lottery numbersssssssss
–Is this where you tell stock fortunes?
–I only trust the prophet…
–Prophet? lol
–This bi*ch hasn’t seen the broadcast lololol
‘How did it end up like this?’
‘Ah, right, I should ban the bi*ch who called me a prophet.’
associated_names: I'm a Fortune Teller, Not a Prophet! (Novelpia Global)

113487.synopsis:
Yin Liuming suffered from severe insomnia, and when he couldn’t sleep, he became irritable.
To solve this, he signed a contract with Shen Lou, the book spirit of the Nightmare Game illustration book, voluntarily entering the game. He offered his body as a sacrifice to collect monsters in exchange for a chance to cure his insomnia.
And so, the players in the game discovered that this newcomer who partnered with them was a two-faced person.
During the day, Yin Liuming was gentle and humble, winning people over with his integrity. He elegantly subdued the monster as he remarked, “A two-star, mhm… I guess it can barely be used.”
At night, Yin Liuming was violent and easily irritated, subduing monsters with brute force. He would beat and tear apart any monster that dared provoke him, then ruthlessly add it to his illustration book. “Three stars, useless.”
Other players, exhausted and struggling to survive, watched Yin Liuming’s performance. Their faces change from shock to numbness.
—While other players are fighting to survive, you’re out here hunting monsters?
After another morning of grumpiness, Yin Liuming nearly destroyed half the instance.
Shen Lou smiled. “You want to sleep? I can help with that.”
Yin Liuming glanced sideways at Shen Lou. “You’re stronger than a five-star monster?”
“You can give it a try.”
Then he did give it a try.
Soon, Yin Liuming realized that Shen Lou was indeed more powerful than a five-star monster.
In every sense.
In the past, he had terrible trouble sleeping. Now, he has trouble getting out of bed.
He initially believed Shen Lou wanted his body, and it turned out that Shen Lou really did.

115535.synopsis:
The Great Liang Dynasty had well and truly fallen.
As the rebel army approached the city gates and the capital was on the verge of collapse, the idle Prince Shen Shaoyuan and his daughter crouched inside the royal treasury, trembling, fully prepared to die for their country.
However, the rebels never stormed the vault. Even the faint sounds of battle gradually faded into silence.
Eventually, the father and daughter mustered their courage and pushed open the door to the treasury.
A neighbor passing by with a hoe slung over his shoulder called out, “Old Shen the Seventh, the sun’s out! Time to get to work!”
Good news: They had transmigrated. Their lives were intact. The treasury was still with them.
But—
Bad news: Everything here was vastly different from Great Liang. Flaunting wealth? That was basically asking for death.
Shen Shaoyuan declared firmly, “We’re poor. Dirt poor!”
—
As a commandery princess of Great Liang, Shen Mo’er had received multiple marriage proposals before her transmigration. Her suitors included, but were not limited to: the son of the Grand Councilor, the youngest son of a general, the newly appointed top-ranking scholar, and even the second prince of a neighboring kingdom.
Shen Mo’er had only one requirement for her husband: he had to be good-looking.
Unfortunately, just as stacks of portraits were delivered to the prince’s manor, the rebels launched their attack.
After transmigrating, Shen Mo’er glanced at the treasure vault behind her, then at the neighbors grunting as they carried buckets of manure, and let out a deep sigh.
Fine. She’d change her standards: first, good-looking. Second, poor.
Before long, Shen Mo’er had found her target—the educated youth Fu from the village work brigade. Fair-skinned and handsome, always dressed in tattered clothes. His family must be dirt poor.
He was the one!
Fu Mingze had been sent to the countryside by his family during a time of political tension. Before his departure, his elders had solemnly instructed him: “Just pretend to be poor. That’s your only task. If you find someone suitable, you can marry and settle down in the countryside. Don’t be too picky—just make sure she’s poor.”
Fu Mingze looked at the girl in front of him: messy hair, ragged clothes, but her brightness couldn’t be hidden. And her family was known throughout the village as the most impoverished.
She was the one!
Later—
Shen Mo’er took a fancy to a courtyard house in the capital. “I want to buy this house. Money doesn’t matter.”
The door opened, and standing beneath the osmanthus tree was her husband—supposedly back to visit his impoverished, sickly father—dressed in a tailored suit, his handsome face showing a hint of impatience. “What do we look like? Desperate for money? Not for sale.”
Their eyes met.
Shen Mo’er: Poor? Impoverished, sickly father? Ha! I believed your nonsense!
Well, at least now they didn’t have to pretend anymore.
associated_names: 郡主穿七零後擺爛裝窮[空間]

116303.synopsis:
“Do what you want with my life. Just please, spare my comrades.”
I Mais Wont, who is a [Hero] , sacrificed myself to save my comrades.
What was given to me as compensation was an endless hell.
It hurt.
I was scared.
I wanted them to let me die.
One year later.
I was saved by someone who called themselves a ‘Hero’ and came to be reunited with my comrades.
The joy was brief, as I learned that I had been broken.
More than anything, the way my comrades looked at me had changed.
Their eyes that clouded over every time they looked at me.
Hey……
Why……
Why do you look at me with those eyes……?
associated_names: 仲間を救うため、魔人の捕虜となった。それから一年。変わり果てた俺を見て泣いた

121935.synopsis:
In the Kingdom of Vatis lived Violet, a rabbit beastkin.
She had one troubling concern—her heat cycle had not yet arrived.
Then, one day, she unexpectedly received a marriage proposal from Duke Queensberry, a snake beastkin.
She initially wanted to reject his proposal as they had absolutely no connection,
but due to her family’s failed business, she reluctantly accepted.
And so, two years passed.
During their two-year engagement, Violet underwent bridal training to adapt to the ways of the snake clan.
But then, suddenly, another unexpected event occurred—a letter from the Duke arrived, announcing he was breaking off their engagement.
Having endured the pain of parting with her beloved lover for the sake of this engagement, Violet felt anger and resentment toward the Duke, who had proposed and then broken things off on his own whim.
“Almost all snake clan members are sexually exceptional. There are occasionally some who aren’t, but they’re considered a disgrace to the clan.”
Amidst all this, she obtained useful information:
Being sexually inadequate was shameful for the snake clan.
Violet planned to take revenge using the rabbit clan’s “secret method to reduce s*xual desire”…
* * *
“Why does that look delicious?”
Strangely, her gaze turned toward the Duke’s body as he lay unconscious.
Just moments ago, she had thought that merely touching him was terrible and disgusting!
‘Just once. Yes, just one time—let me taste him!’
The moment the thread of reason in her mind snapped,
Violet reached out toward the man, seemingly possessed.
associated_names: 발칙한 토끼 영애가 냉혈한 뱀 공작을 유혹한 사정

130127.synopsis:
When the Doomsday Game arrives, plants and animals mutate, zombies and ghosts flood into the human world.
Fighting monsters, leveling up, and looting gear becomes the new way for humans to survive.
Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Life Expert talent.
Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Food Appreciation talent.
Beep—Congratulations! You have gained the Medicine Analysis talent.
…Su Ning just wants to say: I think… my life is about to become effortlessly victorious.

142159.synopsis:
At five years old, Inia had a warm, loving family. Like any other child, she lived a simple and blissful life.
Every now and then, some grubby “outsiders” would lose their way and stumble into her dollhouse. She always welcomed them with open arms. What puzzled her, though, was why her new friends would start trembling head to toe and sweating buckets the moment they saw her family.
What Inia didn’t know was that, in the eyes of those “outsiders,” the scene before them was so shocking it sent their SAN values plummeting.
In the [Mechanical Ascension] instance, the hell-level boss who had driven countless players to collapse—and whom no one had ever defeated—was, unexpectedly, a two-headed “male mom” with remarkable cooking skills. Whenever he looked at Nia, a virtual blush would bloom across his electronic screen of a face, as though he couldn’t resist her cuteness.
The cruel, temperamental vampire grand duke of [Nightmare Castle] , who toyed with players as if their lives meant nothing, was actually a doting older brother figure who loved sewing clothes for Nia and her little dolls—and even let her braid his golden hair.
The cold and merciless fallen goddess of [Night of the Fallen God] couldn’t stop herself from smiling like a doting aunt whenever she saw Nia, her frosty, elegant voice softening without her even realizing it…
And that snake-tailed boy who loved slithering through the shadows—his face perpetually cold, yet always quietly stealing Nia away to play on the snake slide—wasn’t he the notorious young villain from the [Cold-Blooded Aberration] instance?!
Even the Nightmare Mother from [Cradle of Dreams] and the Queen from [Hive Crisis] were nothing more than doting aunties in Nia’s eyes *(^▽^)*.
A player stepping into the boss’s lair: “Thanks for the invite. I’ll just go reincarnate now (RIP).”
—
It was said that among the countless horror dungeons, there existed one true safe house. Its master was a sweet little girl—the only dungeon boss who showed players genuine kindness.
Those who respected her, kept her company, and made her happy would be rewarded with treasures beyond measure.
But the greedy ones who dared to harm her would be swallowed whole by the nameless abyss lurking behind her.
Over time, tales and rumors about Inia and her dollhouse spread far and wide. Veteran players often warned newcomers—never, ever speak ill of the little girl in any dungeon!
New players didn’t understand, until they saw some foul-mouthed idiot get chased across the map by monsters, vines, or robots, drawing the wrath of every boss at once…
Someone please help—every single boss in these instances is absurdly obsessed with their little sister!
·
To players, Inia was the little jewel in the monsters’ hands.
But only the monsters knew that the day the little girl appeared in this chaotic world was the day their lives were touched by the most precious spark of hope.
Guide for Readers
•	A daily-life, heartwarming child-raising story with a touch of infinite flow, not hardcore.
•	The main plot follows the bosses raising a child from the moment of her birth—not starting at age five. The excerpt in the blurb reflects a later point in the timeline, not the beginning.
associated_names: 在惊悚副本长大的幼崽

143183.synopsis:
Gerard Castion.
The second son of the Grand Duchy of Castion, which holds sway over both political and economic power, and a hero of the empire who saves its people from monsters.
And yet…
“Lord Castion is quite unfortunate, isn’t he. Out of all his countless memories, why were only the moments of his deepest love completely erased?”
Even he himself doesn’t remember it, but…
He was the man who had been my lover for seven years.
“Do you really think that child can overcome everything with love alone? That my son can be happy while bearing the harshness that has been ingrained by your hands?”
Because I knew he was someone far beyond my reach, I simply watched as he mistook my childhood friend for me and courted her.
Whether in ability or status, she was far superior to me, and he would be happier with her.
But then…
“You.”
“…….”
“Have we really never met before?”
Why must you come back to find me again, even beyond forgotten memories—
“You’re making me do things I’ve never done before. Things that drive me crazy.”
Why are you breaking down the final wall I had built so firmly within myself?
“You can no longer throw me away, Louize. Take responsibility for turning me into this mess.”

149071.synopsis:
In a Middle Eastern country where discrimination against omegas runs deep, Johan, an omega abandoned after his secondary gender manifested, lives alone in an oasis with only a cat for company. One day, he rescues an injured man who has lost all memory of his past. As they spend time together, Johan falls in love with him… but one day, the man suddenly disappears without a trace.
After waiting for him in vain for a long time, Johan unexpectedly encounters the crown prince, a man who looks exactly like the one he once loved. Yet, the prince doesn’t recognize him at all…

154447.synopsis:
[Start as an Abomination] [Eldritch Cultivation] [Recruiting Demons] [Protecting Humanity] [Misunderstanding Followers] [No Romance] 
Chen Zhou transmigrates into a bizarre world overrun by demons and rampant with eldritch horrors.
Here, monsters slaughter humans, spirits torment the living, and Immortals feast upon mankind. Malevolent forces run wild, demons are arrogant, Gods and Buddhas have perished, and the path of humanity is in decline.
Fortunately, the entity Chen Zhou transmigrated into isn’t human either. He begins his journey as an Evil Spirit and activates the Evil God System.
Fresh blood, flesh, souls—whatever an Evil God requires, he can sacrifice it all. As long as he offers sacrifices, he becomes stronger!
But… the system never specified that he had to sacrifice humans, right? Chen Zhou falls into deep contemplation.
[Sacrificed a common 100-year Black Snake Demon. Unlocked Special Building: The Blood Prison Pool!] 
[Sacrificed a Malignant Spirit that slaughtered a city in a vain attempt to become Immortal. Unlocked Minion: The Paper General!] 
[Sacrificed a millennial Living Corpse. Unlocked Exclusive Ability: White Bone Ghost Domain!] 
From that day forth, Chen Zhou established a city within his Ghost Domain. He slaughters Immortals, demons, and spirits alike; he recruits ghostly servants and evil attendants; he shelters the human race, basking in the faith of the masses to prove his Dao as an Evil God.
“Since the Gods and Buddhas of this world refuse to offer salvation, it is up to me, an Evil Spirit, to protect all living beings.”
Using the body of an abomination to stand as an impregnable fortress, performing acts of blessing and grace.
associated_names: 妖魔邪祟? 明明都是祥瑞!

158543.synopsis:
Ye Mu woke up to find himself transmigrated into a cultivation world. Not only had he become the Holy Son of the Blissful Holy Land, envied by all men, he had also awakened the Villain System!
As long as he performed all kinds of villainous acts, he could obtain Luck Points, which could then be exchanged for various items, even boost his cultivation level!
Right at that moment… the female lead—Su Qianqian—came to him, begging for a pill to cure the seriously ill protagonist… In that case, she couldn’t blame him for what came next.
“Hehehe, I can give you the sacred medicine, but… I have one condition…”
Years later… Ye Mu used the Dao of Bliss to prove his path to immortality!
He sat high above the heavens!
By his side were women of all kinds of temperaments, their beauty incomparable…
associated_names: 反派：合歡聖子，女主跪求我放過
玄幻：合欢圣子，开局女主来求药

182095.synopsis:
After waking up, Jiang Yuan was shocked to discover that he had actually turned into a breathtakingly beautiful young girl?!
Luckily, at the critical moment, he successfully bound to the [Game Development Master System] . Through whale-spending and gacha draws, he could earn points, then use those points to exchange for complete information on every game from his previous life: source code, art assets, balance sheets, design documents, everything you could possibly need.
From that moment on, the world lost one naïve and foolish fresh graduate, and gained one impossibly devious, gorgeous cunning game designer!

201551.synopsis:
Having just finished slaying a dragon in the game world, Luo Xiu transmigrated into the world of “Divine Destiny” the very next second.
He possessed the body of a level 1 NPC with the same name, resetting everything to before the server launch.
Only Luo Xiu knew that:
At this time, the Judgment War was on the verge of breaking out, the Scarlet tide was about to sweep across the land, and the Abyss Inverted was already drawing near;
Not to mention the slumbering violent ancient races, the Fallen worlds drifting beyond the starry sky, and the decaying gods that erode everything…
Luo Xiu felt panicked.
I’m tired, let it all be destroyed.jpg
Fortunately, the reward for slaying the dragon in his past life—the Creation-grade item “Abyssal Sacred Codex”—transmigrated with him, along with his mailbox.
Luo Xiu felt he could still be saved!
With Light as his shield, darkness as his spear, raising Angels with Taboo, and bestowing the Holy Light Blessing upon Demons… Luo Xiu, walking both the [Radiance] and [Abyss] Fate Paths, would eventually carve out an unprecedented path.
——————
“Whether it is the Abyss or Radiance, they are both my wings!”
Leader of the Holy Abyss, Gatekeeper of the Calamity, Shadow of the Scarlet, Radiant Wise King, Master of the Abyss, “Ring of Revelation”, Head of the Nine Pillar Gods…
—Luo Xiu, said as much.
In the future of the future, the poets in the taverns chant:
“At the destination of that Fate Path…
They chant an Ode in the Abyss, they Fall in Heaven.
That is the Epic of the old days, the Revelation of grace—
It is the legend of the [Holy Abyss] engraved above the Apocalypse!”
associated_names: 执掌深渊，从见习神官开始
